title: Spiriti! Napoli '97
summary: Tile-engine Naples paranormal arcade tribute with compact indexed sprites.
description: Drive a highly recognizable classic Fiat 500-style response car across a tile-rendered Naples night, answer paranormal calls, dodge ectoplasm, and trap spirits. Runtime graphics combine PRG32 64x32 playfields and 8x8 tiles with compact 4-bpp indexed sprites for the hunter, response car, spirits, Vesuvius boss and props. The audiovisual direction evokes the 1984 paranormal-comedy arcade era through original tribute artwork, capture/siren motifs, call-and-response synth writing and SID-like stereo synthesis, without reproducing protected Ghostbusters logo art, soundtrack melody/recordings, dialogue or original game assets. Unofficial tribute game; unaffiliated with the rights holders.
